must_have_skills: Deep, hands-on expertise in modern training codebases, especially PyTorch (or equivalents).
Strong engineering and software development skills in Python.
Familiarity with job launchers, logging tools (e.g., Weights & Biases, TensorBoard), and checkpointing systems.
nice_to_have_skills: Experience with Transformer models, diffusion models, or other large-scale vision/NLP tasks.
Knowledge of model optimization for inference (e.g., TorchScript, ONNX).
Familiarity with cluster environments: batch schedulers (SLURM) and GPU resource management.
evidence.seniority: Proven, real-world experience training large-scale deep learning models
